audit_scope: Final computational integration; no existing module modified.

observable_wound_geometry.representation: Observed mesh vertices/faces, boundary edges, normals, support, confidence and uncertainty proxy.

sensor_router.inputs: Sensor capabilities and measured geometry/depth quality.
sensor_router.outputs: Route, accept/fallback/rescan/refusal decision, reasons and research-only flags.

boundary_representation.current_demo: Single closed loop on a synthetic disk-shaped wound bed.

uncertainty.source: Observable geometry replay exports a subset-disagreement proxy, not a calibrated probability.
uncertainty.current_demo: Fixed declared synthetic uncertainty; no learned or clinical confidence claim.

target_surface_policies.selected_architecture: Conservative staged filling with an explicit external final target.

limitations: Requires a scalar void shell thickness.
Has no arbitrary target mesh, safety-margin mask, or exclusion-zone input.

existing_robot_model.model: UR5 six-revolute arm plus two-axis gantry, eight degrees of freedom.

existing_robot_adapters.type: MyCobot hardware bridge; explicitly not imported or called.

visualization.source: modules/visualization_3d.py and the RGB/depth notebook render helpers.
visualization.current_demo: OpenCV-generated offline preview clips; not CoppeliaSim camera footage.

input: supported wound-bed mesh in declared scene coordinates

integration_path: Keep sealed geometry and sensor-router artifacts immutable.
Replay declared synthetic mesh and sensor mode into the quality router.
Reject failed cases before planner invocation.
For the supported case, pass mesh, target surface, uncertainty, layer and constraints to the minimal adapter.
Update the synthetic surface after each stage and rescan/replan.
Bind the resulting adapter to UR5/CoppeliaSim only after the runtime and scene are available.
Run IK, collision, camera, and trajectory-completion metrics in CoppeliaSim before calling the integration demonstrated.
